notes: Summary: Elmwood builds a multi-tenant support platform for 300+ mid-market customers. Primary goal is increase ticket deflection and speed up agent resolution with RAG + reranking.
Indexing scale: expect 3-7M docs total after POC; POC will use 500k high-value docs (KB articles, past tickets, policy docs).
Latency targets: product VP: "p95 support answer generation must be <= 300ms (including search+rerank)." Very strict — especially for in-chat agent latency.
Throughput: peak 90 QPS during business hours, tail traffic spikes to 200 QPS on incident days. Need predictable burst model or dedicated capacity.

Quality target: top-5 rerank precision goal ~85-92% (business measures deflection by top-3). Want side-by-side evaluation of dense retrieval + learned reranker (cross-encoder) vs larger embedding+rerank tradeoffs.
Cost sensitivity: target average cost per query (search + rerank) < $0.004 — important constraint for economics across 90k daily queries.
Model preferences: prefer open embeddings (mpnet/sentence-transformers) for baseline; open to Redwood-verified embeddings and quantized reranker variants if they meet SLOs and cost targets.
Security / compliance: customer-managed KMS, SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 12 months, data residency for EU tenants (they have EU customers).
Desired Redwood features: prefix/KV caching to accelerate repeated context, intelligent batching suggestions from Optimize, and routing to cheaper model variants when latency headroom exists.
Quote from product: "If reranker kills latency we lose adoption — need graceful fallback to cheaper rank & cached answers."
POC asks: provide ingest pipeline guide, estimated tokenization footprint, benchmark harness for 500k index and 90 QPS, sample cost model at 90 QPS and 200 QPS bursts.
Sales notes: AE offered trial credits and quickstart repo; provided Drive deck (poc-scope-v1.pdf) and security FAQ. Legal to review retention/processing clauses before Dedicated/VPC commitment.
Potential upsell: Dedicated capacity + Optimize subscription to auto-tune batching and quantization strategies if POC passes.
Competition: Elmwood evaluated Pinecone + cross-encoder flow and Algolia Instant Search for baseline; chose Redwood for unified runtime + explicit routing/fallback controls.
Internal action items: SE to deliver benchmark plan by 2026-03-08; AE to coordinate legal review; provide cost sensitivity matrix to customer.
Customer sentiment: cautiously optimistic; pragmatic about tradeoffs (quality vs cost). Repeatedly asks for concrete latency benchmark results before procurement.
